args.title: Saltmarsh Foods — Retail returns logistics (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
Three-bullet combined summary of Saltmarsh Foods' latest content:

• Newsletter (newsletter@saltmarsh.example, "Retail returns logistics"): This week's theme is retail returns logistics; the full piece is at https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns, and Saltmarsh is also running a related webinar with seats held via a personalised insights.saltmarsh.example link.

• Article (https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns): Apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidating returns into dedicated return hubs cuts handling cost by roughly one-fifth (20%).

• Companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion): Speed is the key lever — items resold within 10 days retained most of their original margin.

Takeaway for SANDPIPER-adjacent work: high return volumes are now a structural cost centre, and the payoff comes from centralising handling plus compressing the resale cycle to under 10 days.
